attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Threshold: 1.0 . Logbase: 2 . Technology: Generic.SingleColor.014850. Normalization: Shift to 75 percentile . Baseline Transformation: median of all samples .

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: RNA was extracted with Trizol (Invitrogen) following the manufacturer's standard protocol, followed by confirmation of RNA integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Complementary RNAs (cRNAs) labeled with Cy5-CTP (Perkin-Elmer) were synthesized from 1 ug of total RNA of each sample using the Low RNA Input Fluorescent Linear Amplification Kit (Agilent Technologies) following the manufacturer's protocol. A reference cRNA, labeled with Cy3-CTP (Perkin-Elmer), was synthesized from 1 ug of sample D2 RNA. Aliquots (750 ng) of Cy3 and Cy5 labeled cRNA targets were co-hybridized on Whole Human Genome Oligo Microarrays (Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Type
attributes.value: nucleic acid hybridization to array protocol

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Microarray hybridization and washing were performed using reagents and instruments (hybridization chambers and rotating oven) as indicated by the manufacturer (Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Type
attributes.value: array scanning and feature extraction protocol

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Microarrays were scanned at 10-um resolution using a GenePix Personal 4100A microarray scanner and the GenePix Pro 6.0 acquisition and data-extraction software (Molecular Devices, Corp.).
